added_failures_note: The reviewed run was suite-unarmed, so its manifest carries neither baseline_suite nor after_suite. The count is derived from the run's own gate logs: logs/head-suite.log and logs/base-suite.log both report the same two failing ids (test_no_removal_site_still_deletes_with_git_worktree_remove, test_no_removal_path_decides_liveness_from_the_phase_gated_claim) with 174 passed on each arm, so the head added no failing test.

findings.text: The landed behaviour has no committed regression test. The only test that fails on it is evidence/test_state_record_commits.py in the run directory, which the repository never runs, so a later edit could drop _recorded_release and leave every gate green.

The per-run branch reloads the record with json.loads(path.read_text()) instead of ledger._read_run (reckon/ledger.py:1268), so a run file whose run_id contradicts its path is accepted here while _update_run_record at reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:560 refuses it.

VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that a crew verb writing a tracked state record commits it; reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:658 makes the release pass read and keep a release already on the record, which is the one case where the pass was rewriting rather than committing.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names three cases; the head arm at 235fe8b1e7 runs tests/test_state_record_commits.py and records 3 passed, and the same file at base c2e2d17f has 1 failed / 2 passed, so the gate asserts the second-release case.
VERDICT write_paths: read from the source manifest; the diff touches reckon/crew/promotion_release.py and docs/evidence/fragments/the-crew-does-its-own-bookkeeping/a-crew-verb-that-writes-a-tracked-state-record-commits-it.html, both declared.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records complete status, the three commits, the head and base arm results, the negative-control log path and the two pre-existing suite failures.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from c2e2d17f2d to 35bee7eb9d; 48d32268f0 adds _recorded_release and its call, 235fe8b1e7 widens its return to carry the record, and 35bee7eb9d adds only the landing fragment.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:3100, reckon/crew/promotion.py:1171, reckon/crew/promotion.py:1799
SCORE goal_fidelity: 17
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:658 keeps the recorded release and returns before any write, so the second pass commits nothing rather than rewriting a true receipt.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: logs/base-arm.log records 1 failed / 2 passed with test_a_second_release_leaves_the_record_byte_identical red at c2e2d17f, and logs/head-arm.log records 3 passed at 235fe8b1e7.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the declared write paths, and reckon/crew/review_dispositions.py was read and correctly left unchanged.
SCORE durability: 8
JUSTIFICATION durability: no committed test in the repository references _recorded_release, so reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:592 is guarded only by evidence/test_state_record_commits.py, which lives in the run directory and never runs in the tree.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: the helper follows the module's private-helper idiom at reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:555 and its docstring states the mechanism without a plan or ticket reference.
SCORE reuse: 15
JUSTIFICATION reuse: reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:613 re-reads a per-run file with raw json.loads where reckon/ledger.py:1268 _read_run already owns that read and validates the run_id.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:592 non-blocking: the landed behaviour has no committed regression test — the only test that fails on it is evidence/test_state_record_commits.py inside the run directory, which the repository never runs, so a later edit could drop _recorded_release and leave every gate green.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:613 non-blocking: the per-run branch reloads the record with json.loads(path.read_text()) instead of ledger._read_run (reckon/ledger.py:1268), so a run file whose run_id contradicts its path is accepted here while _update_run_record at reckon/crew/promotion_release.py:560 refuses the same file.
